Written to `/tmp/report_preview.html` — **44 KB, zero external references, zero `<script>` tags.** Let me verify the two claims that matter most: that no PII is present, and that nothing can phone home.

```python
import re, base64
raw = open("/tmp/report_preview.html", "rb").read()
text = raw.decode("utf-8")

# 1) network / exfil surfaces
for probe in ["http://", "https://", "attacker", "fetch(", "XMLHttpRequest",
              "navigator.sendBeacon", "<link", "@import", "url(", "iframe"]:
    print(f"  {probe:<22}", "FOUND" if probe in text else "absent")

# 2) PII pattern probe on the whole document, tags included
pats = {
    "email shape":   r"[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[\w.]+",
    "phone shape":   r"(?<!\d)(?:\+?\d[\d\s().-]{7,}\d)(?!\d)",
    "uid column":    r"\b(customer_id|account_no|user_id|email|phone|name)\b",
}
print()
for label, p in pats.items():
    hits = re.findall(p, text, flags=re.I)
    print(f"  {label:<14}: {len(hits)} hit(s) {hits[:3]}")

# 3) are the embedded images really opaque bitmaps?
imgs = re.findall(r'data:image/png;base64,([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)', text)
print(f"\n  embedded images: {len(imgs)}")
for i, b in enumerate(imgs, 1):
    blob = base64.b64decode(b)
    print(f"    img{i}: sig={blob[:4]!r}  {len(blob)/1024:.1f} KB  "
          f"chunks_scrubbed={not any(t in blob for t in (b'tEXt', b'iTXt', b'tIME'))}")
```
